title: Cobblenautics!
description: What happens if you take Cobblemon, Create: Aeronautics, and a few other odds and ends and THROW EM ALL IN A BLENDER
body:
### <center> Welcome to Cobblenautics!
 <center> 
   
   ##### [Discord](https://discord.gg/8hq3wvbzvT)
   

<hr/> 

So, basically, take Create: Aeronautics,\
Cobblemon, and a few other odds and ends\
AND THROW EM ALL IN A BLENDER

</center>
<hr/>

###  <center> Primary Features

- **✈️ Explore** - Construct any vehicle you can think of with [Create: Aeronautics](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics)
- **🥅 Capture** - Build the team of your dreams with [Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon)
 
- **🔮 Arcane Discovery** - Converse with the old ones with [Occultism](https://modrinth.com/mod/occultism) 
- **➕And more!** - Cant give away all the fun now, can I?
<hr/>
